content: macOS Sequoia (15.0+) removed the Control-click 'Open' Gatekeeper bypass for unsigned/unnotarized apps. Current flow: user double-clicks app, gets blocked with 'Not Opened' dialog, must open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll to bottom, click 'Open Anyway' (password/Touch ID required), then re-launch the app from Finder and click 'Open Anyway' again in a second dialog. The button only appears after a first failed launch attempt, and must be clicked within about an hour. Confirmed through macOS 15.1 and macOS 26 Tahoe.
